column2: General our troops situation in Sevastopol is desperate.  They are completly surrounded in the city of Sevastopol. You have to find an evacuation path. The Germans have cooperated with a small submarine fleet and some merchant ships. Good luck!!!
Playing tip: You can always cross rivers using PORT hexes (use the
Strategic Transport button when you right-click on a unit), from Yalta to Krasnodar. Infantry units can still move after landing.
General you succeeded in an impossible situation !!! You found a path and almost all our troops escaped.  They will live to fight another day !!!
Ploesti (#11) - June 5, 1944
The Western Allieds launch a massive air attack against the Romanian oil installations at Ploesti.  Commando actions are coordinated with the air raid.

General intelligence reports show that the Western Allies will try to destroy our oil installations in Ploesti.  They plan an attack with a massive air force plus paradrops and commando actions.  General an urgent message!!! The Americans have taken control of some local airfields under cover of a huge air fleet. You should intervene immediately!!!
General you have saved our oil installations. You have inflicted great losses to the Allies air forces plus destroying a good number of their best commando units.
Army Group Southern Ukraine (#12) - August 7, 1944
The II and III Ukrainian Fronts attack the Axis Southern Ukraine Army Group across the Dniestr river.  A Soviet victory will lead to the destruction of the Army Group and the occupation of Romania.

General the Soviets are attacking with overwhelming superiority the Army Group Southern Ukraine. Our troops are demoralized and are escaping without a fight.  General Fiessner have asked that you take command of all our troops.  Many of the veterans of your victories during the Stalingrad and Crimea campaigns are there.  They will take heart if you are there to lead!!!\x00
Comrade General: This is your opportunity to expel the German facists from Lithuania and open the road to Germany itself at East Prussia! You will command the First Baltic Front!
General you stopped the Soviets and rallied our men !!! You have saved the Army Group and stop the invasion of our motherland!!!

General you narrowly achieved victory and held the Soviets away from the border. A new goverment has taken charge in Bucharest!!! They have signed an armistice with the Soviets. Our country's destiny is unknown!!! Better do not return!!!
Carpathian Mountains (#13) - October 11, 1944
The Romanians try desperately to close the mountain passes to the Red Army. A successful defense could save the country from invasion.

General King Michael has deposed Marshal Antonescu!!! A transition cabinet has taken the goverment !!! They have requested an armistice from the Soviets.  They have refused. The II Ukrainian Front is invading the country through the Carpathian Mountains. They plan to occupy us and terminate our independence !!! You should close the mountain passes before is too late!!!\x00
General your wonderful victory has completely closed the mountain passes to the Soviet troops !!! They will have to agree to an armistice now !!!
The subs are at the bottom of the ocean. But now our men must recuperate from this shallow victory before we can proceed to our next objective.
Hungarian Plains (#14) - December 11, 1944
The Romanians invade Hungary alongside the Red Army.  They are trying to settle old feuds with the Hungarians.

General the Soviets have made many concessions and an alliance has been established. You have been selected to lead our 4th Army in the invasion of Hungary. It is time to settle old scores with the Hungarians. Good luck!!!

Field Marshal you have achieved a complete victory!!! Your great victory has earned the respect of the Soviets!!! We can expect an independent Romania to emerge from the war!!! You have earned the gratitude of your country forever!!!
Oder River (impassable)
Warta River (Impassable)
Spree River (Impassable)

Comrade General Feld-Marschall von Manstein is attacking in great force to release the surrounding forces at Stalingrad! We need to stop them before is too late! You should take command of the Fifty First Army the only force in their path. The Second Guard Army will join you as soon as possible!

Comrade General you failed to stop the Germans at the Myshkova! Marshall Zhukov have decided to flank them by adestrying the Eigth Italian Army covering the Don river. Do not fail us again or you will feel Vassiliev's wrath! Kotelnikovo is your objective!

Comrade General Feld-Marschall von Manstein is attacking in great force our forces trying to reach the Dnieper crossings! Karkhov recently liberated is threatened again! You shoul take command and stop the German counterattack!
The people celebrates your recent victory ! Time is needed to rebuild those installations, this time is long enough for us to destroy them.
You did it Commander.  We got what we came for. You've done a fine job for us.  It's time to go home.  You've done your country proud.  Here, have a cigar! See you stateside.
Comrade General you have disrupted completely the German plans by forcing the river and establishing a big beachhead on the right bank of the Dnepr river.
Congratulations, once more time you've demonstrated your skills.
Our Italian friends thank you for your assitance. The British have been hit again.
Comrade General: Comrade Stalin is very pleased with your performance!!! You have recovered most of Lithuania and crossed the German border!!!
Comrade General: You have liberated Kiev the Ukrainian capital. We should complete the liberation of the Ukraine and push the Germans from Russian territory!
Comrade General: You have taken Kiev the Ukrainian capital. Your indecision has allowed the Germans to withdraw most of their troops though. Yopu have to do better than that Comrade!
Sicily - November 15th, 1945
Comrade! we have a critical situation! we've been removed a large amount of equipment from Italy without realizing that the allies were preparing a massive counter-attack.
You are the nearest General with available troops, your mission is stop that offensive, otherwise our rearguard will be exposed.
General, we have appreciated your heroic efforts to stop that offensive.
After their defeat, the allies will not surrender.
Comrade Stalin wants to invade Great Britain.
Metz - December 12th, 1945
Comrade, you have begun the invasion of France, your goal is to take the fortified city of Metz.
Intelligence data confirm the arrival of an Allied contingent.
Excellent!! our objectives has been completed, now begins the hard part of the operation.
Comrade, this brilliant victory was achieved due to the superiority of Communism over the Nazism. Now we shall pursue these scums to the Berlin and liberate the working people in the whole Europe!
This is the end, try to escape anywhere while you can, before the allies turns you into a prisoner of war.
The red dream is over.
Comrade, we have put the Allies in a corner against the coast, now we have to hurry up to avoid the mistake that the Nazis made.
Caen - February 8th, 1946

France is falling in front of us. We have broken the country in two, and practically the victory couldn't resist us, however one more time the Allies are sending their troops in a stupid attempt to stop us... One more time, the socialism will give them a lesson leading to the conquest of France.
After the conquest of Attu, we could say the US navy has been almost destroyed. Now we will capture a military base in Alaska in order to have a beachhead to start the invasion of the mainland.
The Allies have destroyed your troops. This is a horrible treachery for our people, for the PCUS, and for Stalin. Your next destination is Siberia.
Finally, we have accomplished our objectives. The enemies fought very well, but they couldn't stop us.
Barcelona - March 18th, 1946

Comrade, after the conquest of France, we couldn't forget Spain, which is an important strategical point, but is an very important political objective. The illegal goverment has been established after the criminal war started in 1936 by the fascists with "counselors" sent by Germany which aimed at destroying our motherland. Our mission here is to conquer this important way to the Mediterranean sea and to liberate Spain from the fascism. Good Luck, comrade.
That was a little too close for my liking general.
Our only chance is to move west faster than Ivan can respond.  Pick up
the pace.
Well, what about being a captain now? We have always claimed you had been the traitor of the Rodina...
Congratulations, Commander.  Your capture of Pantelleria has opened the way to Sicily. Now we will attack the enemy in his homeland!
Red Lion - April 1st, 1946

Good Morning comrade. With all the French ports under our control, it's time to cross the English Channel and pursuit the British in their homeland. General Zhukov and his troops will join you in order to invade the South England area. Stavka have designed a special operation to incur a minimum number of casualities. You must follow these steps;

A) At first, you must destroy the allied fleet on the Channel, our fleet will arrive from the Baltic to accomplish this task. Soviet submarines recently developed may strongly help you. Be aware that if you try to drive your troops without sunking the enemy fleet, they will destroy your troops.
B) The enemy resistance on the other side of the Channel will be very strong, you must plan your steps, in order to win.

Playing tip: (1) place amphibious ships on any adjacent hex to the coast in order to deploy your troops whenever you want (one unique ship can deploy your whole army). (2) It is also possible to move ground units from PORT to PORT hexes using the strategic transport option when right-clicking on a sea liftable unit. (3) It is also possible to make an extensive use of paratroops.
Perfect, the weapon has been destroyed, and now we have the information about their construction, ...  Now, its time to attack the USA mainland!. Good times are waiting for the socialism!
As we expected this battle has finished with our victory. The Brits are rookies when driving armored divisions.
London - April 30th, 1946

The disembark has been succesful, but now we've reached the heart of the British Empire: London. I am sure that the red flag will look very well in the top of the Big Ben. Churchill and the Royal Family have escaped from the country, and they are travelling to Canada, the British moral is broken, but it will not avoid a furious fight on the suburbs of London. Good Luck... you will need it.
This is today the greatest victory for Comunism, comrade...

Well, your performance was lower that we had initially expected, anyway, you will receive much prestige to buy new transports. We know that it isn't enough, but our supply line was seriously blocked due to your delay.
The Germans have pushed us back.  We will be lucky if we can hold Antwerp. The war may still be lost!  You are ordered back to London where you will face a firing squad!
Vladivostok - June 1st, 1946
Comrade, our victories have blinded us from the Allies plans of an invasion from the east.
We know that your army is tired, but the Americans are preparing an invasion to Vladivostok, and we have to stop it at all cost.
US Forces drive into the Southern Flank of the Soviet advance
Sakhalin: "Operation Engels" - December 7th, 1946

They tried (cowardly) to attack our motherland with a ridiculous invasion, but they couldn't did it. North American troops are trapped in the island of Sakhalin, which Americans thought using as a base to manage the invasion. STAVKA has designed a operation to free Sakhalin and to capture the invaders, maybe we could destroy the Americans Pacific Fleet, that is anchoraged near to Poronask.
You must follow the next steps, comrade:
A) Soviet troops have disembarked towards the South-West of the island, pursueing the remaining north American troops from Vladivostok. You must destroy those troops.

B) Reinforcements of our comrades paratroopers will arrive from the north. With the paratroopers and with the help of one division of mountain troops, you must take the airport to the north. You can deploy troops via the reinforced mobile army HQ units, protect them!
That's all, good luck comrade.
The American presence in our motherland has been eliminated with one hit. I am sure that they won't try any more similar thing. Good work!
Well done, Commander. You've got the Krauts high-tailing it back to the fatherland. Looks like you might get another star for this one. Good job son.
The Allied forces attempt to breakout in Normandy against the Germans.
Commander, you are losing our prestige to the world, the situation is so critical that we have no choice and we have to defend Moscow.
Berlin - May 8th, 1945
Good Day, this is the situation: Patton has archieve his goals and now is marching on Berlin, you have two new divisions to stop the allies, you will receive heavy reinforcements from the north.
Take control of Berlin.
Hokkaido - June 30, 1946

Our next step on the Pacific is in front of us. The north Americans are reagrouping troops in their Japanese bases. Japan is basically an American military colony after the US victory over this country. Our agents have provided us some informations, such as the remaning ships from the US navy are on the area. The Chinese comunist leader, Mao-Tse-Tung may help us in the first step of our plans in Japan with some chinese troops, with some equipment that we've sent them.
Playing tip: move transport ships on any adjacent hex to the coast in order to deploy your troops (one single ship can disembark all your units).
Very good work comrade!, a beachhead has been established in Hokkaido, now we can drive to Tokyo. This time we'll put the red flag in Hiro Hito's Imperial Palace.

Impressive comrade!!!, we've destroyed the capitalist invader!!!. I am sure the Finnish will welcom the new socialist goverment that we'll establish in Finland...
Tokyo - July 7th, 1946

Comrade, this is the last stand in Tokyo. The enemy is regrouping his troops in the Japanese capital, Tokyo. The main Japanese island is enclosed by our submarines, the yankees only can receive reinforcements from the south. This will be the final blow for the Americans in Japan.
Finally, we have accomplished our objectives. The enemy fought very well, but he couldn't stop us.
Aleutian Islands - August 6th, 1946

Stalin has ordered to invade the USA, in revenge for the cowardly invasion they did in Vladivostok. After their losses on the Pacific, US navy became weak, and the remaining north American troops in all the world are in the way to defend the USA's mainland. Firstly, our amphibious forces may attack the Aleoutians, that we will use as a base for future attacks on the USA west coast. Your mission is to manage this special amphibious Soviet forces.
After the conquest of Attu, we could say the US navy has been almost destroyed. Now we will take a militar base in Alaska in order to have a beachhead to start the invasion of the mainland.
L.A. '46 - August 16th, 1946

The yankees are waiting us on San Francisco, but in truth we'll disembark in Los Angeles and surprise them. After around a hundred years, north Americans will have the war in their own homeland. Our paratroopers have landed in a place named "Hollywood" in order to capture a nearly airport. Your mission is to disembark your troops and make a beachhead, and later, take the big city of Los Angeles. Be aware, if our comrades paratroopers fall, our mission will be a failure.
Comrade... all the socialist world is celebrating this victory... without any enemy in the Pacific, we'll use Los Angeles as a base for the invasion of the remaining US states...
This is not possible! Comrade Stalin has been killed, and the Soviet Union is totally under chaos.
We have made a peace agreement in poor conditions with the Americans.
Assassination attempt on Stalin - September 8th, 1946
General, the Americans are trying their last revenge to defeat us.
Intelligence reports are showing that an attack to the Kremblin is expected with the idea to kill Comrade Josef Stalin himself, "the little father of Peoples".

Your mission will be to prevent this attack and to locate the place where terrorists took radio contact with Yankees. You are allowed to deploy only two of your best units. Fly to Moscow at once! Once captured bring traitors to the Lubyanka for interrogation purposes. Failure is not an option. Dismissed comrade General!
Playing tip : (1) Protect the Kremlin at all costs (2) Poke around forests south of Moscow to discover the HQ (sole hidden VH) where traitors are hiding.
Counter Attack
Chicago - September 24th, 1946
Greetings Comrade, the Americans didn´t expected a fast advance of our armies, so their units are well covered, but poorly defended.
Your assignment will be to attack the industrial complex of Chicago and to prevent the Americans from using one of their main production centers.
Take advantange of this surprise advance and take easily the city.
Commander, you barely escaped disaster. We need commanders who can win decisively. You will be reassigned to our infantry training center as permanent latrine orderly!
Washington - November 1st, 1946
General, the time has come to our last target, the attack to the capital city.
Remember that our troops in America are limited, don´t try a direct attack to the center.
Destroy patiently the defenses to avoid massive casualities.
Beware of any special weapon Yankees tested in Dutch Harbour...
The absolute glory depend of you.
DEFEAT IS NOT AN OPTION.

Playing tip: (1) Use also Battleship "Moscow" to debark your core forces (the ship stands on a supply hex). (2) Use strategic transport button by right clicking on a unit in order to move it from PORT to PORT hexes (Queenstown to Annapolis) provided that no enemy unit stands between the ports.
Moscow - July 2nd, 1946
Comrade, we have a hard situation, the allies surround Moscow and Stalin won´t escape.
You must reach Moscow and kill everyone at your advance.
Comrade, things back to normal in Moscow, and the allies propose us a decent peace agreement if we give them Stalin... After all, Stalin isn´t the brillant leader that we´ve thought.

Okay, Commander, here's the deal.  We've been here for two months now.  We've got to push the Krauts out of Metz.  Once we've done that, we can smash through the Maginot Line and drive into Germany.  I'm counting on you and your men.  Good luck.
Comrade, you have chosen the French path.
Austria - May 18th 1945
Comrade, we have information that the "allies" are moving equipment in order to surround us in Germany.
Your mission will be the destruction of this movement to protect our rearguard.
Excellent Comrade, you got control the front and eliminate the allies source, now is time to extend the soviet frontier.
Choice 2 - October 2nd, 1946
General, after so many fights, Comrade Stalin himself will ask you about your next assignment.
Your choice Tovaritch ?
BV: Invasion of Spain (easy)
V or TV : Invasion of Great Britain (hard), codenamed "Red Lion"
Comrade, you have chosen the Spanish path.
Comrade, you have chosen the British path.
Kazan - June 15th, 1946
Comrade, here there are the Americans, I know that wasn´t easy to escape from their hands, but beyond the river, we have a heavy defense line.
Your assignment will be to merge your units to that defense line and to destroy those bastards.\x00
Sabotage - May 15th, 1945
Since you are one of the best and experimented officers, you have been selected
to a special assignment. As you know, the United States had launched two atomic bombs over Japan.
The Japanese had their "reward", but this might happen to us too.
Our spies have discovered the secret atomic bomb production center, your mission is to destroy it.
We have a plan, use the first group of spies to attract the attention in order to leave their base with less defenses, and with the second group cut the fence and destroy the installations.
The future of the Soviet Union depends on you Comrade General!
General Tito
Dutch Harbour - August 10th, 1946

Comrade, after our first victory in the Aleoutians, we have received some informations from our spies on the Military base in Dutch Harbour (Alaska): the Yankees aided by some German scientists, are designing a horrible weapon, capable to reach our motherland on one shot. STAVKA has marked the possible zone where the weapon is hidden by the Yankees. Our spies are a group of guards, dissidents from the capitalist system. You can identify him by his grey mark. STAVKA will be pleased if you save him, because the enemies have discovered that they are sending us informations. We don't know if the weapon is ready for shot... be aware.

Perfect, the weapon has been destroyed, and now we have the information about their construction, ...  Now, its time to attack the USA mainland! Good times are waiting for the socialism!
General, this triumph is a fitting end to the war. Hitler is destroyed and the world cheers your victory. Your name is mentioned everywhere. Some say you may become the next Prime Minister!
New York 46 - November 12th, 1946

Some US old guard generals refuse to surrender to the Soviet forces. Those generals are trying to keep alive the flame of the resistance in the formerly World Capital: New York. STAVKA cannot tolerate this and prepares a powerful offensive to defeat the last resistance pocket in North America.

The Soviet "Pensylvanya Front" is attacking from the North, and it's already smashing the US defenses in the "Queens" quarter, while forces from the "NY Front" are heading to overrun the pocket of Brooklyn and then, join the forces coming from the North in order to cross the East river and smash the whole Manhattan, where the resistance will surely be even harder.
Can the Red Flag be installed on the Statue of Liberty and Wall Street ?

Commander, to have come so far at such cost, and then to have failed is utterly galling.  I have no doubt that you tried your best, but sadly, a try is not good enough. In spite of your forgettable performance, we have won the war. I bid you farewell.
Finland - June 4th, 1945

Comrade, Stavka has made a campaign over the Scandinavian peninsula to destroy all possible threats that might arise by crossing Norway and Finland. After your success in Germany and Austria, you must cross the boundary with Finland to save Leningrad and Murmansk against any future allied attacks. Comrade, Stalin and the Party expect that one more time you'll get the victory.
The British showed us a fierce resistance, but finally they have been defeated. Now, we can build here our HQ and start receiving supplies from the Continental soil.
The allies have destroyed your troops. This is a horrible deception for our people, for the PCUS, and for Stalin. Your next destination is Siberia.
Impressive comrade!!!, we've destroyed the capitalist invader!!!. I am sure the Finnish will welcome the new socialist goverment that we'll establish in Finland...
Norway - June 10th, 1945

Comrade, a proper socialist goverment has been established in Finland after our victory. Our campaign over Scandinavia must continue just now in Norway, before the allies can put a foot on Scandinavia. We have reports that the remaining Germans on Norway are helping the allies to build up a defense line against us, it would be a pleasure to destroy them once more.

General, this loss is the last straw. Hitler has now consolidated his power in Norway and it will be years before we can launch an attack in the region. You have disgraced the British Army. A firing squad is in order!
Comrade General, thanks to your previous merits and Comrade Zhukov's personal intercession you have saved your head. Now you have to rebuild your corps.
Greece - June 25th, 1945

The dissarray of the greeks against their goverment has lead to a people's revolution, where the comunists greek partisans are taking the lead of that revolt. Our mission is to help the partisans in their fight. In all the ways, Stavka have been planed to attack Greece to avoid a potential allied land here. Our comrades spies are sending reports us about the allied presence in this area, take care, a defeat here will bring the allies the opportunity to attack our motherland.\x00\x00
Comrade General, in reward of your bravery and devotion Comrade Stalin on Marshal Zhukov's proposal has charged you with the task of assaulting Berlin!!!
Low Countries - July 30th, 1945

Comrade, the war continues to be well, we are showing the world that the socialist system is most advancend than the corrupted capitalist system. One more time, our spies from the NKVD are giving us important informations; the British are disembarking a big number of troops in the Low Countries and in some areas of France, they have the help from the remaining German troops in those zones, one more time. It's highly important that the allies do not establish a beachhead on the Low Countries. Good Luck, comrade.

Playing tip : Use ground units starting from any PORT hex and select strategic transport to capture Amsterdam harbour (PORT hex) or use paratroops to capture Amsterdam (VH). Seaborne or airborne operations are both possible.
Good work, the allies are re-embarking their troops, in order to avoid their capture.
Tutorial - Madrid Offensive

Belgium - August 10th, 1945

Lenin would have never thought arriving so near from United Kingdom, we can say, after all, we're in the bigger war in all history, that without any doubt will put the USSR in the world lead. Firstly, we'll destroy the allied presence in west Europe. The general Charles de Gaulle is managing the defence of Belgium, maybe we'll have the oportunity to ask him about his anti-comunism ideas. Good Luck, comrade, Im sure all workers around the world expect our victory.
That was close General, but you pulled it off.
Our flank is secure so keep moving West.
